culprit_citations.quoted_text: Hudson Technologies Company | Last Out Term Loan - 12.31 % ... | Amortized Cost $ 5,964,585 | Fair Value $ 6,059,560

findings.detail: FX02 rows store fair_value_currency as U_USD even though the SOI Fair Value column is dollar-denominated; normalize U_USD to USD for these BDC fair-value facts.

rationale: Class 1 currency-cell check. The flagged rows have observed fair_value_currency U_USD, but the raw schedule of investments presents fair value amounts in a dollar-denominated Fair Value column. Table 5 row 4 explicitly shows dollar signs for amortized cost and fair value, and table 6 row 29 confirms total investments are also presented with dollar signs. The source supports USD, not U_USD, so the non-USD currency value is a real normalization/extraction error. No aggregate anchor was needed.
